content.text:
You have a few good options, depending on whether you want **same-day/local delivery** or a **shipped specialty cake**:

### Best places to order online

- **Instacart** — good for same-day or scheduled delivery from local grocery stores like Costco, Publix, Safeway, Kroger, Wegmans, etc. You can search “birthday cake” and see what’s available near the recipient. ([instacart.com](https://www.instacart.com/store/s?k=birthday+cakes&utm_source=openai))  
- **Whole Foods Market** — offers cakes and some online ordering for pickup or delivery where available; especially popular for Berry Chantilly and other bakery cakes. ([wholefoodsmarket.com](https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com/departments/bakery/cakes?utm_source=openai))  
- **Goldbelly** — best for special “wow” cakes shipped nationwide from famous bakeries. Good if you don’t need same-day delivery. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?irgwc=1&utm_source=openai))  
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — specializes in nationwide birthday cake delivery and gift-style cake shipments. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Carlo’s Bakery** — ships cakes and desserts nationwide, with some local pickup options depending on location. ([shop.carlosbakery.com](https://shop.carlosbakery.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Local bakeries via Google, DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub** — often best for custom writing, specific flavors, or last-minute delivery.

### Quick recommendation
If you need it **today or tomorrow**, use **Instacart** or a **local bakery**.  
If you want something more memorable and can wait a few days, use **Goldbelly**, **Bake Me A Wish!**, or **Carlo’s Bakery**.

If you tell me the **delivery city/ZIP code** and the **date you need it**, I can help narrow down the best options.
